messages:
Maya: hey team — opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/2487
Maya: tl;dr: unify REST <-> streaming header behaviour for tool-calls across py/js SDKs; adds small header shim to preserve backward compatibility for older proxies
Maya: tests added for header mapping but CI flaky on macOS runner, need an extra pair of eyes before we merge :wave:
pr-bot: CI: github/checks — 3 checks pending, 1 failed (macos-unit-tests)
Devin: taking a look shortly. rough change size?
Maya: ~120 lines in py client + 80 in js shim + tests
Olivia: can we avoid any user-facing API break? is schema the same?
Maya: no public API changes; only internal header rename mapping. calling code unaffected. Marked non-breaking in PR body.
Sam: quick read — looks fine. small nit: the shim key is `X-Tool-Call` vs `x-toolcall`? casing matters for some proxies.
Maya: ah good catch — current patch normalizes to lowercase before comparing. here's the snippet:
```
key = key.lower()
if key in ("x-tool-call", "x-toolcall"):
    # map to canonical
```
Devin: can you add a short changelog line and a test that asserts header normalization for mixed-case?
Maya: will add changelog + test in next commit, rerunning CI now
pr-bot: CI: github/checks — all checks running
pr-bot: CI: github/checks — macos-unit-tests failed (flaky) — re-run requested by @Maya
Olivia: if mac runner keeps failing we can queue merge on canary with rollback flag enabled
Sam: i can approve once the macos test is green. @Devin want to queue approval too?
Devin: i'll give an LGTM after the changelog/test. thanks
Maya: pushed changelog + test. new commit 9c3f2b — re-run CI
pr-bot: CI: github/checks — all green :tada:
Sam: approved :white_check_mark:
Devin: LGTM — go ahead and merge when ready. :ship:
Maya: merging now — thanks all :raised_hands:
